summary: Accessible operational-level World War II wargame series focused on supply, maneuver, and tightly designed historical campaigns.

entries.title: Unity of Command: Stalingrad Campaign
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with Red Turn and Black Turn expansions

emulation.notes: No emulation needed for the primary route.

primary.version: Windows PC release with Red Turn and Black Turn expansions
primary.why: Windows is the most practical capture route and supports the full original campaign plus the Red Turn and Black Turn expansion content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC release and include Red Turn: The Road to Berlin 1943-45 and Black Turn: Operation Barbarossa 1941 for the complete first-game package.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC operational wargame with expansion support.

entries.title: Unity of Command II
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with all current campaign DLC

primary.version: Windows PC release with all current campaign DLC
primary.why: Unity of Command II is Windows-only and the Steam/PC route carries the full campaign-DLC library, making it the only complete version.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC release and install the campaign DLC library from Steam if doing full coverage beyond the base Allied campaign.

all_releases.fidelity: Native 3D-engine Windows operational wargame with ongoing campaign DLC library.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows is the only documented release platform and complete DLC route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No console or remaster route; DLC completeness should be checked against the Steam DLC page before a full campaign marathon.
